port:\\\\n\\\\n```sh\\\\nPORT=3000 ./run.sh\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n`run.sh` replaces its shell with Puma through `rackup`, binds it to\\\\n`127.0.0.1`, and keeps the server in the foreground.  In another shell, a\\\\nminimal smoke check is:\\\\n\\\\n```sh\\\\ncurl --fail http://127.0.0.1:3000/health\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\nThe response is `{\\\\\\\"ok\\\\\\\":true}`.  Before submitting a change, at minimum run\\\\n`ruby -c app.rb`; run the cumulative benchmark evaluator when it is available\\\\nin the surrounding benchmark environment.  Do not start a long-running server\\\\nas part of static verification.\\\\n\\\\n## Entry points and layout\\\\n\\\\nThis intentionally minimal Rails API is kept in a small number of root files:\\\\n\\\\n- `run.sh` is the server command used by the benchmark.\\\\n- `config.ru` requires `app.rb` and exposes `Rails.application` to Rack.\\\\n- `app.rb` defines the Rails application, controllers, shared domain helpers,\\\\n  SQLite storage, and all routes.  It loads only the Rails controller stack;\\\\n  Active Record and Rails migrations are deliberately not used.\\\\n- `Gemfile` and `Gemfile.lock` pin the Rails/Rack/Puma runtime.\\\\n\\\\n## Request routing and state\\\\n\\\\n`DndApi.routes` at the end of `app.rb` is the authoritative route list.\\\\nControllers inherit from `ApplicationController`, which parses request JSON,\\\\nnormalizes integer inputs, and renders the common invalid-request response.\\\\n\\\\n`GameStorage` owns the SQLite connection, schema setup, reset operation, and a\\\\nprocess-local mutex.  Its database file is `game.db` beside `app.rb` and\\\\npersists users, combat sessions, compendium records, and campaign records\\\\nacross server restarts.  `GameStorage.initialize_schema!` runs during boot.\\\\nAll storage reads and writes are made inside `GameStorage.synchronize` so the\\\\nsingle shared SQLite connection is used safely by Puma threads.  Storage reset\\\\nis intentionally exposed through `POST /v1/storage/reset` and is the only API\\\\noperation that clears persisted state.\\\\n\\\\n## API/domain groupings\\\\n\\\\n- Core rules: health, dice statistics, ability checks, initiative ordering,\\\\n  characters, and adjusted encounter XP.\\\\n- Combat and auth: persistent combat sessions/conditions/turn advancement and\\\\n  SQLite-backed user registration/login.  `CombatSessionState` and\\\\n  `AuthCredentials` hold their non-routing mechanics.\\\\n- Compendium and campaigns: monster/item records, campaign characters/events,\\\\n  persistent scheduled sessions/attendance, and a campaign state view.\\\\n- PHB utilities: spell slots, long-rest recovery, and equipment load.\\\\n- DM tools: encounter building from campaign/compendium data, deterministic\\\\n  tier-one loot, and the latest campaign-event recap.  `EncounterMath` is\\\\n  shared by the core and DM encounter endpoints to keep their XP behavior in\\\\n  lockstep.\\\\n\\\\n## Safe extension and testing conventions\\\\n\\\\nPreserve the existing route, status-code, response-shape, validation, and\\\\npersistence contracts: the benchmark is cumulative.  Put controller-only\\\\nrequest handling in the relevant controller and extract only genuinely shared,\\\\nside-effect-free logic into a focused module.  Keep database access inside the\\\\nstorage mutex and use parameterized SQL.  Add schema changes to\\\\n`GameStorage.initialize_schema!` and ensure `reset!` drops any new tables.\\\\n\\\\nPrefer deterministic ordering and values; existing APIs intentionally sort\\\\ninitiative and query campaign collections by insertion order.  Exercise a\\\\nfeature through HTTP after resetting storage, then rerun the cumulative suite\\\\nto catch interactions with earlier domains.\\\\n\\\\n--- RUN ---\\\\n#!/usr/bin/env bash\\\\nset -euo
